why: The map checks named paths, inherited directory responsibilities and the retired-module boundary, not volatile inventories. Independent miniature fixtures break every registered claim; the real tracked tree is checked separately.

mutations.name: a broken named path is accepted
mutations.breaks: The broken named path and explicit wrong-root fixtures must fail even when ownership coverage remains valid.

mutations.name: a new top-level ownership directory inherits the area heading
mutations.breaks: Unowned cmd, internal and public roots must fail; ordinary internal/kmx packages inherit their root and keep documentation locally.
mutations.find: if len(parts) <= depth or owner not in named:

mutations.name: missing kmx package documentation is accepted
mutations.breaks: Missing, empty, detached, directive-only and test-only documentation must not satisfy the package-doc claim.
mutations.find: if not any(go_package_documented(tree.read(path)) for path in files)]

mutations.name: no claim is registered and the run reports the map checked
mutations.breaks: An empty registry must not pass either a valid miniature map or its negative fixtures.

mutations.name: the findings are collected and the exit code ignores them
mutations.breaks: A fixture disagreement must produce a failing verdict, independently of the comparison code producing the finding.
